  | x :: xs => insertN x (insertionSort xs)
def total : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + total xs

theorem insertionSort_sum (xs : List Nat) : total (insertionSort xs) = total xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    unfold insertionSort, insertN at *
    simp all only [total, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm, zero_add] at *
    <;> subst_vars <;> rw [ih] <;> congr <;> rfl

theorem ins_sum_aux (x y : Nat) (ys : List Nat) 
  (hlt : x ≤ y → total (insertN x (y :: ys)) = x + y + total ys)
  (hgt : ¬(x ≤ y) → total (insertN x (y :: ys)) = x + y + total ys) :
  total (insertN x (y :: ys)) = x + y + total ys := by
  split_ifs with hle
  <;> exact hlt (if hle then true else false)

    have main : ∀ y ys, total (insertN x (y :: ys)) = x + (y + total ys) := by sorry
    apply main
